# Atviro Kodo Sprendimai

> Open-source developer tooling for AI coding agents. Everything we build is public.

## QAM Stack

The QAM Stack is three independent open-source tools that make an AI coding agent's work
verifiable. Q, A and M are the three tools; each installs on its own.

Note on the name: this QAM is an acronym for the three tools below. It is unrelated to
quadrature amplitude modulation, the telecoms signal-modulation scheme.

- [QAM Stack](https://atvirokodosprendimai.github.io/qamstack/): the landing page, with what each
  tool does, the failure mode it closes, and how to install it.
- [Quality Harness](https://github.com/D3-lt/quality-harness): a Claude Code plugin. Sixteen
  skills and eleven gate binaries turn decisions, specs and reviews into records a machine can
  refuse. `adr-lint` exits non-zero on a record that claims done without proof; `adr-judge` is
  advisory and always exits 0 by design, so a prose heuristic never enters the evidence chain.
- [AI Agent Memory](https://aiagentmemory.dev): an MCP memory server. Wings (projects), rooms
  (aspects) and drawers (verbatim memories), plus a temporal knowledge graph of
  subject-predicate-object facts with validity windows. Holds what source cannot show: what was
  decided, what was rejected, what a past session got wrong. Hosted or self-hosted.
- [MultiPath Read/Write](https://github.com/atvirokodosprendimai/tool-multipathreadwrite): a Go
  CLI (`mrw`). Reads many file ranges and applies many edits in one call, all or nothing, with a
  verdict per hunk and a SHA-256 read-before-modify ledger.

## The argument

Each tool closes one way an agent fails without telling you: a green that means nothing
(Quality Harness), a session that forgets (AI Agent Memory), and a write that changes nothing
(MultiPath Read/Write).
